guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以硫化物生成、逸散、腐蝕證據與控制邊界為主線，從厭氧停留與來源、總硫化物水相負荷、pH 與水相分配、跌水逸散與氣相量測進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops sulfide generation, release, corrosion evidence and control boundaries through ten connected units, beginning with anaerobic retention and sources, total aqueous sulfide load, ph and aqueous speciation, release at drops and gas monitoring. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「厭氧停留與來源」的觀測點。以槽有效容積與示蹤劑穿透曲線交叉檢查。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「總硫化物水相負荷」的觀測點。採樣保存與分析方法成對記錄，對比流量加權樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「pH 與水相分配」的觀測點。以封閉自動取樣資料比較 pH、硫化物與氣相讀值；不進入管渠。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「跌水逸散與氣相量測」的觀測點。同步量氣體流量、溫壓及成分，確認採樣代表性。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「冠部酸蝕與材料損失」的觀測點。對照多點厚度、材料、含濕與酸性表面紀錄。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「通風與密閉空間邊界」的觀測點。在模型上比對送排風位置與氣體感測覆蓋，操作僅限模擬。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「源頭控制方案比較」的觀測點。以藥液消耗稱重與處理水量交叉核對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「內襯與檢查覆蓋」的觀測點。將遠端影像、厚度測點與管段里程對齊，標示遮蔽區。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「處理床穿透監測」的觀測點。比對床前床後同時採樣與氣體分析校正。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「腐蝕控制成效回訪」的觀測點。對照多點厚度、材料、含濕與酸性表面紀錄。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for anaerobic retention and sources. Cross-check effective volume with a tracer breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for total aqueous sulfide load. Record preservation and analytical methods together and compare flow-weighted samples. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for ph and aqueous speciation. Compare closed automated samples for pH/sulfide with gas readings; do not enter sewers. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for release at drops and gas monitoring. Synchronize gas flow, temperature, pressure and composition and verify representative sampling. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for crown acid attack and material loss. Compare multiple thickness points, material, moisture and acidic-surface records. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for ventilation and confined-space boundaries. Compare supply/exhaust placement and gas-sensor coverage in simulation only. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for comparing source-control options. Cross-check weighed reagent consumption against treated flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for lining and inspection coverage. Align remote imagery and thickness measurements to chainage and mark occluded regions. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for treatment-bed breakthrough. Compare simultaneous upstream/downstream samples and gas-analyzer calibration. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for follow-up of corrosion control. Compare multiple thickness points, material, moisture and acidic-surface records. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 只檢查臭味出口而未追溯上游生成區。診斷與介入：用示蹤曲線及有效容積修正假設，先在模擬中比較分流方案。
硫與 H2S 分子質量混用。診斷與介入：核對保存、氧化及揮發損失，重新建立硫質量基準。
把水相 H2S 算式當作空氣安全證明。診斷與介入：校正水相 pH、溫度及保存方法，另用氣相量測判讀逸散。
不同溫壓條件的氣體數字直接相乘。診斷與介入：統一溫壓與成分單位，再配對風量與濃度。
沉積層厚度被當作完整結構厚度。診斷與介入：重測同點及鄰近材料厚度，保留局部失效與結構評估。
以鼻子是否聞到判斷 H2S 是否存在。診斷與介入：查實測風量、死角及持續產氣；密閉空間程序不能以此比值取代。
只看臭味變少而未量總硫及下游影響。診斷與介入：核對活性成分、流量和投加量換算，避免把示例作為推薦設定。
有影像的區域完好便推定全管完好。診斷與介入：補上遮蔽及未測區域，避免以部分影像推定全線完好。
只量出口但未知道入口負荷上升。診斷與介入：同步測入口與出口氣體成分，另檢查環境暴露監測。
短期低臭味被當作多年壽命保證。診斷與介入：重測同點及鄰近材料厚度，保留局部失效與結構評估。
pitfallsEn: Only the odor outlet is checked, leaving upstream generation unmapped. Diagnostic response: Revise assumptions using tracing/effective volume and compare flow-distribution options in simulation first.
Sulfur mass and H2S molecular mass are mixed. Diagnostic response: Check preservation, oxidation and volatilization losses and rebuild the sulfur basis.
An aqueous-H2S calculation is used as proof of air safety. Diagnostic response: Correct aqueous pH, temperature and preservation, using separate gas measurements for release.
Gas measurements from different reference conditions are multiplied directly. Diagnostic response: Unify temperature/pressure and composition units before pairing flow/concentration.
Deposit thickness is confused with sound structural thickness. Diagnostic response: Remeasure matched/adjacent thickness and retain localized-failure/structural assessment.
Smell is used to decide whether H2S is present. Diagnostic response: Check airflow, dead zones and continuing generation; the ratio does not replace confined-space procedures.
Reduced odor is accepted without sulfur or downstream checks. Diagnostic response: Check active strength, flow and dosing conversion; do not use the example as a recommended setting.
Sound photographed areas are taken as proof that the whole pipe is sound. Diagnostic response: Add occluded/unmeasured regions rather than inferring whole-line condition from partial images.
Only the outlet is measured, hiding rising inlet load. Diagnostic response: Measure matching inlet/outlet gases and separately check ambient-exposure monitoring.
Short-term odor reduction is treated as a multiyear life guarantee. Diagnostic response: Remeasure matched/adjacent thickness and retain localized-failure/structural assessment.

courses.connection: 本課以硫化物生成、逸散、腐蝕證據與控制邊界為主線，從厭氧停留與來源、總硫化物水相負荷、pH 與水相分配、跌水逸散與氣相量測進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops sulfide generation, release, corrosion evidence and control boundaries through ten connected units, beginning with anaerobic retention and sources, total aqueous sulfide load, ph and aqueous speciation, release at drops and gas monitoring. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
